objectives: Find information at Dead Man's Drink
Choose a bowl at the altar
Wait for your wish to be granted
Read the Note from the Temple of Kynareth
Find a ferryman who will take you to Giant's Tooth
Investigate the area around Giant's Tooth
Return to the mainland with the ingredient
Ask an alchemist about the Ironwood Fruit
Read the Note from the Temple of Kynareth
Craft the Ironwood Soup at a cooking station
Give the Ironwood Soup to the temple priestess
Wait an entire day for Rulnik to heal

closes: Only one bowl can be filled; the other two wishes are lost.

people.role: any of them can tell you about the Ironwood Fruit: Arcadia (Whiterun), Frida (Dawnstar), Elgrim (Riften), Bothela (Markarth), Lami (Morthal), Quintus Navale (Windhelm), Vivienne Onis (Solitude), Zaria (Falkreath)

people.name: Neski Skull-Sabre
people.role: from this add-on; the records place her in The Pit, Falkreath, which may be the dungeon you wake in on the power path

unsure.why: No dialogue or event in these files starts the quest. The opening journal line suggests it starts on its own.
The dagger, the two healing spells and the ring are in the quest's script, but the records don't say which path or step gives each. They are probably on the 'nothing' path.
Giant's Tooth has its own map space and the records don't give its hold. The quest has ferry spots at Solitude, Windhelm and Dawnstar; the cave there seems to be Iron Tusk Cave.

Rulnik isn't placed in these files. The power path's dungeon is never named in the journal; The Pit is a guess from where this add-on's people are placed. Danica's other daytime routines depend on conditions these files don't decode.

Harlaug and Ysleif are both placed at the same spot in the records, the place where the quest also puts ice wraiths, and that seems to be Giant's Tooth. The records tie Harlaug to Dawnstar's ferry and to the Pale, but they don't confirm where you first meet him.
